keyVerseDR: "The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in a field." (Mt 13:44)

level1.title: Hidden Treasure
level1.story: Jesus said the Kingdom is like a treasure hidden in a field. A man sold everything to buy that field. Jesus is our greatest treasure!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, You are my treasure. Amen.

activity.title: The hidden treasure
activity.intro: Rub a coin under the paper, then draw the treasure chest.
activity.prompt: A treasure chest hidden in a field, full of shining coins

level2.title: The Pearl of Great Price
level2.story: Jesus said the kingdom of heaven is like a treasure buried in a field. A man found it, and out of joy he sold all he had and bought that field. The kingdom is also like a merchant searching for fine pearls. When he found one pearl of great price, he sold everything to buy it. Jesus also said the kingdom is like a net that gathers every kind of fish.
level2.keyLine: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in a field.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did they give up everything with joy?
actions: Give up a distraction for prayer
level2.prayer: Jesus, You are worth more than everything. Amen.

activity.title: What is my treasure?
activity.intro: Write what you would give up for Jesus, and what He gives you.

art.mainBrief: Man digging up a treasure chest; merchant with a pearl
